title: Cut Blocks for the Mason
summary: Colm Coalhill wants 4 cut blocks from the quarry yard taken to Tegan Rimmer before the next shift goes down, and then a word.
offer_text: "We need cut blocks, and what is stacked at the quarry yard is the town's to take. Carry it to Tegan Rimmer before the next shift goes down, then come and tell me."
turn_in_text: "Good. That is one thing in Stonehollow that goes right."

objectives.text: Take 4 cut blocks from the pile
Hand the cut blocks to Tegan Rimmer
Tell Colm Coalhill it is done

relationship.label: Ran an errand for the town
